start.title: Starting a project
start.body: Tap "New project" on the home screen and pick one or more videos/photos from your gallery. The selection order becomes the timeline order. Templates build a ready-made edit that you can change afterwards.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.body: The white line in the middle is the playhead. Scroll the timeline with your finger to reach any frame. Pinch with two fingers to zoom. Tap a clip to select it; its tools appear in the bottom bar.

trim.title: Split, trim and reorder
trim.body: Drag the white handles on the edges of the selected clip to trim its start or end. "Split" cuts the clip in two at the playhead. Long-press a clip and drag to change its order.

text.title: Text
text.body: Text > Add text places a text layer at the playhead. Drag it on the preview, pinch to scale and rotate, double-tap to edit. Style, color, stroke and animations are in the text panel.

audio.title: Music & audio
audio.body: Audio > Add music places an audio file from your device at the playhead. Long-press audio clips to move them and drag their edges to trim. Fade in/out is in the volume panel.

effects.title: Filters, effects & transitions
effects.body: Select a clip and tap Filters, Adjust or Effects. Tap the small square between two clips to add a transition. "Apply to all" copies the setting to every clip.

export.title: Exporting
export.body: Use the Export button at the top right to choose resolution, frame rate and quality. Only the options supported by your device's hardware encoder are enabled. When finished, the video is saved to the Movies/Kurgu folder in your gallery.

save.title: Saving & undo
save.body: Every change is saved automatically. The previous save is kept as a backup; if the app closes unexpectedly, the project opens from the last good save. Undo/Redo works for up to 100 steps.

missing.title: Missing media
missing.body: If a media file was deleted or the project came from another device, a warning appears. Tap it and pick the file again to relink; your edits are kept.

ai.title: AI tools
ai.notice: These tools are not yet connected to a model or service, so they cannot be used. Below you can see whether each will run on the device or in the cloud. Cloud tools will only send data with your explicit permission.

mode.onDevice: On-device model (download required, no internet needed)
mode.cloud: Cloud service (internet, account and permission required)

autoCaptions.title: Auto captions
autoCaptions.desc: Transcribes speech and creates timed caption layers (Whisper-class model, Turkish included).

removeBackground.title: Remove background
removeBackground.desc: Separates people from the background (segmentation model).

silenceRemoval.title: Remove silences
silenceRemoval.desc: Finds silent parts and suggests cuts.

sceneDetect.title: Scene detection
sceneDetect.desc: Automatically splits long videos at scene changes.

autoCut.title: Auto edit
autoCut.desc: Extracts short, rhythmic clips from a long video.

templates.title: Templates
templates.hint: Choose a template, then pick your media. The result is a fully editable project.

storyIntro.name: Story intro
storyIntro.desc: Vertical, vivid opener with soft transitions

youtubeIntro.name: YouTube intro
youtubeIntro.desc: Landscape, cinematic title and lower third

news.name: News
news.desc: Clean news layout with lower thirds

fx.maxReached: A clip can have at most 4 effects.

perf.heavy: Heavy processing: preview may slow down on older devices

glow.name: Glow
glow.desc: Soft light halo around bright areas.

lightLeak.name: Light leak
lightLeak.desc: Warm film light bleeding in from the edges.

glitch.name: Digital glitch
glitch.desc: Block shifts, tearing and color channel splits.

vhs.name: VHS tape
vhs.desc: Chroma bleed, tracking band and analog noise.

shake.name: Camera shake
shake.desc: Natural handheld jitter and impact shake.

tiltShift.name: Miniature (tilt-shift)
tiltShift.desc: Blurs outside the focus band for a model-world look.

oldFilm.name: Old film
oldFilm.desc: Grain, dust, scratches and flickering exposure.

crt.name: CRT screen
crt.desc: Curved tube screen, scanlines and phosphor mask.

neonEdge.name: Neon outline
neonEdge.desc: Turns edges into color-flowing neon lines.

comic.name: Comic
comic.desc: Pop-art color steps, ink outline and halftone dots.

kaleidoscope.name: Kaleidoscope
kaleidoscope.desc: Splits the image into rotating mirror slices.

ripple.name: Water ripple
ripple.desc: Ring waves spreading from the center.

zoomBlur.name: Zoom blur
zoomBlur.desc: Radial speed blur with a beat pulse.

motionBlur.name: Motion blur
motionBlur.desc: Directional speed trail with highlight smear.

snow.name: Snow
snow.desc: Layered snowflakes drifting in the wind.

rain.name: Rain
rain.desc: Slanted rain streaks and a darker sky.

anamorphic.name: Anamorphic flare
anamorphic.desc: Horizontal cinema streaks from light sources.

duotone.name: Duotone
duotone.desc: Paints the image with a two-color poster palette.

mosaic.name: Mosaic
mosaic.desc: Breaks the image into square or hexagonal tiles, with optional bevel and grout.
